joints.method: Joint offsets fitted to SAM 2.1 arm silhouettes, then refitted with teleop grasp points; two fits that matched the silhouettes equally well differed by up to 7 degrees per joint. The robot's LeRobot calibration file is not in the released dataset

control.method: Not in the released dataset. The twin assumed LeRobot v0.6.0's servo gains (P 16, I 0, D 32); NVIDIA's SO-101 stack uses I 16 [unverified], so the deployed gains are unknown

actuators.method: One gain scale and one force limit per arm joint and a shared 2-step action delay, fitted by tracking logged teleop actions on episodes 1839-1863; validation RMS 0.59-1.98 degrees per arm joint on episodes 1864-1888, gripper not scored. Gains and force limits are not separately identifiable from teleop data. No excitation recording exists

cameras.method: Intrinsics and pose fitted to arm silhouettes; the recording-session pose taken from the session's own top view

Intrinsics and pose fitted to arm silhouettes; focal length differed by 7% between equally good fits. Recording-session pose by transfer from the printed floor mat: residual median 19.3 mm and 2.90 degrees, near-optimal poses up to about 50 mm apart
Intrinsics and a correction to the Menagerie camera mount pose fitted to jaw masks

scene.method: Object sizes and layouts from top-view SAM masks and grasp kinematics; the basket rim height was never measured. The arm sat inside the reconstructed basket in 29 of 30 real ACT layouts. ArmnetBench did not record initial object positions (arXiv 2611.03168v2)

note: Our SO-101 twin as of 2026-11-24. Every input was inferred from the released ArmnetBench data (armnet/armnetbench_v01_lerobot_so101 at 1db69c8) or is missing, so the twin is uncalibrated and no sim-versus-real number made with it is a comparison result. The fitted parameter file is not published; actuators.parameters gives its SHA-256. This record lists no inferred value as measured. robot_unit null: we found no statement in the release of which arm ran the ACT episodes. sessions empty: we did not establish the recording sessions or their dates
